core_limit.name: Core memories per request
core_limit.hint: Maximum number of visible core memories loaded each turn (1–20). Does not limit stored memories.

zh.name: 每轮核心记忆数
zh.hint: 每轮加载的可见核心记忆上限（1–20），不限制存储条数。

recall_limit.name: Retrieved memories per request
recall_limit.hint: Maximum final results for automatic recall (1–20), after candidate retrieval and optional reranking. Vector retrieval and reranking are optional; keyword search alone needs no model calls.

zh.name: 每轮检索记忆数
zh.hint: 候选检索及可选重排序后，自动召回的最终结果上限（1–20）。向量检索和重排序均可选，仅关键词检索无需模型调用。

bm25_candidates.name: BM25 recall candidate count
bm25_candidates.hint: Maximum BM25 candidates before fusion and reranking for automatic recall and recall preview (1–1000, default 50). Independent of tool pagination and the final result count.

zh.hint: 自动召回及模拟召回中，融合和重排序前的 BM25 候选上限（1–1000，默认 50），独立于工具分页和最终结果条数。
zh.name: BM25 召回候选数

recall_query_char_limit.name: Recall query character limit
recall_query_char_limit.hint: Maximum characters in the combined recall query from the latest three messages. Default 0 means unlimited. A positive integer keeps only the first N characters. Applies equally to conversations and recall preview; the selected Embedding or Rerank service may have its own input limits.

zh.name: 召回查询字符上限
zh.hint: 最近三条消息合并后的召回查询字符上限，默认 0 表示不限制。设置正整数后仅保留前 N 个字符，对真实对话和模拟召回同时生效；所选 Embedding 或 Rerank 服务可能另有输入限制。

recall_timeout.name: Total recall timeout
recall_timeout.hint: Total retrieval budget for conversations and recall preview (1–30 seconds, default 5), including core memory loading, BM25, Embedding, reranking and queue waits. Cancels unfinished work and uses results already obtained when the budget expires. Tool pagination keeps its per-request model timeouts.

zh.name: 召回总超时
zh.hint: 真实对话和模拟召回的检索总预算（1–30 秒，默认 5），包含核心记忆读取、BM25、Embedding、重排序及排队等待；到期取消未完成任务，使用已取得的结果。工具分页仍使用各模型请求的独立超时。

prompt_char_budget.name: Memory context character budget
prompt_char_budget.hint: Character budget for memory records injected per request (1500–20000), split between core and retrieved records.

zh.name: 记忆上下文字符预算
zh.hint: 每轮注入记忆记录的字符预算（1500–20000），由核心记忆和检索记忆分配。

search_char_budget.name: Memory search response character budget
search_char_budget.hint: Character budget per search response (5000–30000). Use pagination or a memory ID for more records.

zh.name: 记忆检索返回字符预算
zh.hint: 每次检索返回记录的字符预算（5000–30000），可通过分页或记忆 ID 获取更多内容。

embedding.name: Embedding
embedding.hint: Optional remote vector retrieval and its automatic recall candidate budget.

zh.hint: 可选的远程向量检索及其自动召回候选预算。
zh.name: Embedding 向量检索

enabled.name: Vector retrieval
enabled.hint: Optional remote Embedding API for hybrid recall. Disabled by default. Enabling sends memory text to the selected provider and builds a background index. Missing NumPy dependencies are installed automatically at plugin startup; failed installs can be retried from the memory dashboard.

zh.name: 向量检索
zh.hint: 默认关闭。开启后通过远程 Embedding API 增强召回，会将记忆正文发送给所选服务商，并在后台构建索引；插件启动时自动安装缺失的 NumPy 依赖，安装失败可在记忆管理页重试。

model.hint: Select an existing remote Embedding model. Leave empty to use the default Embedding model. Reuse requires the same underlying model, even if names differ between channels. Only vector dimensions are checked. Changing models requires a manual WebUI rebuild, which may incur significant API costs. Dimension mismatches never trigger automatic rebuilds.
model.name: Memory embedding model

zh.name: 记忆 Embedding 模型
zh.hint: 选择已有的远程 Embedding 模型，留空使用默认 Embedding 模型。请使用相同底层模型，渠道名称可不同；系统只检查向量维度。换模型需到 WebUI 手动重建，可能产生较多 API 费用；维度不一致时不会自动重建。

timeout.name: Embedding timeout
timeout.hint: Maximum seconds per Embedding request (1–30), including concurrency wait. Failures fall back to keyword retrieval.

zh.name: Embedding 请求超时
zh.hint: 每次请求的最长等待秒数（1–30），包含并发排队时间。失败时回退到关键词检索。

min_similarity.name: Minimum vector similarity
min_similarity.hint: Minimum cosine similarity for semantic candidates (0–1). Tune using recall preview for the selected model.

zh.name: 最低向量相似度
zh.hint: 语义候选的最低余弦相似度（0–1），可根据所选模型在模拟召回中调整。

candidates.name: Embedding recall candidate count
candidates.hint: Maximum semantic candidates before fusion and reranking for automatic recall and recall preview (1–1000, default 50). Candidates must meet the minimum similarity. Does not limit indexed memories or tool pagination.

zh.hint: 自动召回及模拟召回中，融合和重排序前的语义候选上限（1–1000，默认 50），仅保留满足最低相似度的记忆；不限制索引条数和工具分页。
zh.name: Embedding 召回候选数

rerank.name: Rerank
rerank.hint: Optional reranking of retrieved candidates, independent of vector retrieval.

zh.hint: 对检索候选进行可选重排序，可独立于向量检索使用。
zh.name: Rerank 重排序
Rerank 重排序
zh.hint: 默认关闭，可独立于向量检索使用。将检索词和候选记忆正文发送给所选服务商，会增加延迟和 API 费用；失败时保留原始排序。

enabled.hint: Optional remote reranking of retrieved candidates. Disabled by default and independent of vector retrieval. Sends the query and candidate memory text to the selected provider, adding latency and API costs. Failures retain the original order.
enabled.name: Rerank

model.name: Memory rerank model
model.hint: Select an existing rerank model. Leave empty to use the default rerank model. No index rebuild is needed when changing this model.

zh.name: 记忆 Rerank 模型
zh.hint: 选择已有的重排序模型，留空使用本体默认重排序模型。更换此模型无需重建索引。

zh.name: Rerank 候选数
zh.hint: 选取最终结果前，对前 2–100 条候选重排序（默认 30）。每次最多发送 60000 字符的候选正文，每条最多 4000 字符；窗口外的候选保留原始顺序。 此设置不会扩大任一路检索的候选池。

candidates.hint: Rerank the first 2–100 retrieved candidates before selecting the final results (default 30). Each request sends at most 60,000 document characters, with at most 4,000 per memory. Candidates beyond this window retain their original order. This does not increase the candidate count of either retrieval channel.
candidates.name: Rerank candidate count

zh.name: Rerank 请求超时
zh.hint: 每次请求的最长等待秒数（1–30），包含并发排队时间。失败时保留原始排序，并暂停重试 30 秒。

timeout.hint: Maximum seconds per rerank request (1–30), including concurrency wait. Failures retain the original order and pause retries for 30 seconds.
timeout.name: Rerank timeout
